boundaries: Product is not Method or Goal.
Product is not Product Feature, Product Capability, Bounded Context, repository, directory, or implementation.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines Product meaning only. It does not admit or instantiate Craft, select a Bounded Context, or authorize migration or implementation.

scope.applicability: A durable identity that owns a coherent promise of value, purpose, and product meaning across the projects and realizations used to develop it.
exclusions: A Method used to build systems.
A Product Feature, Product Capability, repository, package, directory, Bounded Context, or implementation.

examples: Craft embodies CAV2-D20 without becoming the Craft Method.
domain_context.explanation: Craft is the current name of the same Product lineage formerly called DomainSpec v2. This Definition gives Product a new Lab semantic ID because the source corpus has no exact Product Definition ID to preserve.

plain_language.explanation: A Product is the enduring thing that promises value. Projects organize work around it, and methods help build it, but neither is the Product itself.

boundary_conditions: A shared name, owner, path, or relation does not collapse Product with another identity.
Product placement does not create a Bounded Context.
scientific_formal.formal_expression: Product(p) = (identity, purpose, value_promise, lineage, owner_route); related(p,x) does not imply p = x.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Product is a durable identity-bearing boundary for a coherent purpose and promise of value. It may be coordinated by Projects, embody Methods, contain Product Features and Capabilities, and have many realizations, but none of those relations merges their identities or transfers their authority.

notation.meaning: A separately identified Project, Method, Feature, Capability, context, or realization.

testable_conditions: The Product has a stable ID and owner route.
Every related identity has its own ID and typed relation.
No Product identity is inferred from a directory name.
